usage: 熱水 is used as a noun to refer to water that is heated above room temperature.
It can be used to talk about water for drinking, bathing, or cooking.
熱水 can be combined with verbs like 備 (bei6) to mean ‘prepare hot water’ or 開 (hoi1) to mean ‘turn on hot water’.
The word 熱水 often appears in everyday conversations about household utilities.
You can use 熱水 with measure words like 碗 (wun2) or 杯 (bui1) when referring to servings or cups of hot water.
